The text includes "ProdSeller.com" and the slogan "SELLERS OF DIGITAL PRODUCTS." Below this are logos for various AI services (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Copilot) and categories like Books, Courses, Templates, and Software. There are no faces or flags.

**Image 3 (Official Channel):**
This is a **logo**. It is identical to the second image, featuring the same shopping bag/"P" hybrid icon and text layout ("ProdSeller.com", "SELLERS OF DIGITAL PRODUCTS"). It also includes the same row of AI service icons and product category tags. There are no human faces, characters, or national flags visible.
